questions: Which of the cross-repo issue-shape findings are genuine?
Does the shared detector back a fail-closed gate?
Does any test pin the current behaviour?

findings.statement: 5 of 17 cross-repo issue-shape findings name this repository itself; the detector matches the Repo-hash-number shape without excluding the scanned repository
findings.evidence: github_surface scan: five self-named findings across five pr bodies

findings.statement: The sibling URL detector already excludes self via _SELF_REPO at publication_boundary_lint.py:92; the issue-shape loop at :94-95 appends unconditionally
A bare hash-number reference already passes as a self-reference while the same reference in qualified form is flagged: one reference, two forms, opposite verdicts
findings.evidence: executed scan_text matrix over five shapes

findings.statement: scan_text backs the fail-closed tracked-file lint and the read-only GitHub scan. The tracked-file lint scans git ls-files plus --others --exclude-standard, so it covers this phase own uncommitted artifacts: 23 findings before markers, 0 with exit 0 after anonymisation and marking
No test pins that a self-reference is flagged; the existing test uses a foreign-repo fixture and asserts a bare hash-number reference passes

CORRECTED. An earlier form of this finding said that naming an outside repository in prose is not a violation because the operator terms overlay does not list it. That is wrong. The policy is doctrine-publication-boundary :5-7 and :20-23, which prohibit repository names outright; the overlay is a local detection aid that CI does not load. Absence from the overlay establishes non-detection, not permission, so those references are undetected violations belonging to GH #431

The issue-shape regex requires an uppercase initial, so an all-lowercase repository name in the same shape is never matched. Pre-existing and not introduced here; stated because it bounds what a clean scan means
findings.evidence: executed: lowercase form clean, capitalized form flagged

findings.statement: A plan document quoting these findings trips the fail-closed lint 23 times. The doctrine grants a per-line exception for a specification describing the detector; the plan carries it, and an earlier draft misused it to park a real outside identifier rather than anonymise it
findings.evidence: publication_boundary_lint against the authored plan, before and after
